per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The app should follow corporate UI standards (header, search box, toolbar actions) to reduce learning time.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall comply with the corporate standards for user interface creation for internally and externally used applications.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The app should be colorblind-friendly with icons + text labels and high contrast.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall comply with the corporate standards for user interface creation for internally and externally used applications.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The app should provide hover previews for case details to avoid opening each one.
The app should not have overly strict forms where all fields are mandatory.
The app should support two days of hands-on training for full adoption.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: '100% of the cardmember and merchant services representatives shall use the Disputes application regularly after a 2-day training course.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The app should have a maximum of five seconds for screen transitions; faster for small actions (e.g., tab switching).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The maximum wait time for a user navigating from one screen to another within the Disputes application shall be no more than 5 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The app should show progress indicators during slow operations (e.g., loading transaction history).
The app must be available 24/7 with minimal downtime.
The app should have acceptable maintenance windows: 3 AM (Mon-Sat) for 1 hour; Sunday early morning for longer backups.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The app should allow read-only access during maintenance to finish work.
Transaction details, member info, and merchant data must pull from master systems (not cached copies).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall interface with the Statement Database. The Statement Database provides the transaction details to the Disputes System. All transaction details must be obtained from the Statement Database'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Cached data must be clearly labeled with a timestamp if shown.
Only certain roles (reps, supervisors, investigators) should initiate disputes.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes application shall ensure that only users with the appropriate access level are allowed to initiate dispute requests.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: All actions (who opened/viewed/edited cases, timestamps, escalations) must be logged for audit trails.
Supervisors need logged, approved exceptions for cross-base access.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The Disputes System must prevent users from accessing any dispute cases that do not belong to their cardholder base.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Correspondence must use approved templates with required language.

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: 100% of reps (including temps) should use the app post-training.
